desc: The Orlivane A5 journal cover is a refillable faux leather (PU) cover for A5 notebook inserts. Inside are 3 card slots, a front pocket and elastic cords that hold the inserts; an elastic band keeps it closed. Open size about 17.6 x 6.69 in (44.7 x 23.5 cm). Package includes 1 cover only; insert, pen and phone are not included.
b: REFILLABLE A5 COVER — A vintage-style faux leather (PU) cover that holds A5 inserts with elastic cords, so you can swap in a new notebook when one is full. Insert not included.
INSIDE STORAGE — 3 card slots on the left and a front pocket on the right for a phone, pen or receipts.
ELASTIC BAND CLOSURE — A black elastic band wraps around the cover to keep it closed in a bag.
SIZE — Open size about 17.6 x 6.69 in (44.7 x 23.5 cm), about 157 g. Metal eyelets at the spine.
5 COLORS — Brown, black, coffee, wine red and green. Package includes 1 journal cover only; notebook insert, pen and phone are not included.
